name: web-video-presentation
description: Turn scripts, articles, lessons, product demos, and talks into click-driven 16:9 web presentations, with two renderers: Vite (interactive preview / screen-record) + Remotion (offline .mp4 export). Ships a shared truth-source (shared/chapters), a (chapter, step) cursor model, hard collaboration checkpoints, theme-token architecture with image visualAnchors for cross-prompt style locking, and a first-chapter reference-image workflow for visual consistency.
